source_en: Oh, fantastic. Another fresh inspector. Did they pull you straight out of the academy, or did you just get lost on the way to a real posting?
Three tours. I've done the real thing. Every checkpoint, same scene, clean uniform, that little hopeful look. You all have it. You all lose it.
So what exactly did they prepare you for? Go on, be honest.
The basics. Enough to do the job.
The basics. Right. That'll keep you breathing for maybe forty-eight hours. Maybe.
Ha. I'll give you credit for not lying to my face. Doesn't change anything, you won't last.
I'll be generous. Three days. Four if nothing interesting shows up. And it will.
Last guy they put here gave me that same look you're giving me now. Two weeks in, he saw something he couldn't explain. Tried to flag it. Nobody listened. After that, neither did he.
So settle in, Inspector. Put your little stamp on things. Make it feel like you're in control, because that's all this is, a feeling. And out here that feeling goes away fast, before you...
